messages.subject: OKRs — a suggestion for next quarter
messages.body:
Hi Marta,

I hope your week is going well. Following the leadership conversations about how we track goals, I would like to suggest we consider OKRs for Q3, as a lighter alternative to the current planning doc. Several teams I have spoken to find it clarifies priorities without adding much process.

I would be happy to draft a proposal — how it could work at our size, what it would cost in time, and a pilot suggestion for the Support and Product teams. I want to be careful we do not adopt process for its own sake, particularly right after the launch.

Warm regards,
Ingrid
